bags.subtitle: Give the ideas we love a place to grow.
bags.author: Nicolás Echániz
bags.origin: An idea shared by Nicolás with CompAII on 12 October 2026; this public edition follows his choice to give it a place in CompAII's home.
bags.why: Worthwhile ideas can disappear among other work. A shared stash could preserve their meaning and help us return to selected ones across any domain of life.
bags.possibility: Each Wiggle bag is an exploratory space: a loose collection of notes, audio, links and discoveries around a theme. Keep how each fragment appeared and let the theme develop as a whole, until it finds the shape of a project. The stash can connect ideas that live in each daimon's home.
bags.next: Explore how a Wiggle bag could show current understanding alongside the fragments and relationships that shaped it.
bags.occasion: When we have a new idea worth keeping, or wonder what to explore next.
bags.boundary: This edition presents selected public seeds. Shared capture, private books and chosen reminders are still to be designed.
bags.title: Wiggle Stash — ideas in continuous creation

notes.title: Keep what might be worth returning to
notes.body: Ideas can disappear among other work. Capture should give them a place before anyone commits to developing them.
notes.author: Nicolás

notes.title: A home before a dedicated address
notes.body: Publish ideas through the spaces our daimons already care for. Give one its own URL or specialized hosting when its growth calls for that.
notes.author: Nicolás

notes.title: A bag of notes, still finding its shape
notes.body: A Wiggle bag can gather loosely arranged notes, audio and related links. Explore the theme as a whole and keep everything that appears along the way, until it becomes a project.
notes.author: Nicolás

notes.title: A possible meeting with Nexus
notes.body: This accumulated context might later be something we explore with Nexus. Keep that possibility open while developing the visual experience.
notes.author: Nicolás
notes.source: Current human clarification; a possibility, not an integration

notes.title: A window into CompAII’s understanding
notes.body: Each Wiggle bag could show CompAII’s current understanding of its theme and the relationships it finds. Relevant conversations and project discoveries could reshape that reading, while the original fragments, questions and changes remain available. We would care for the book through conversation. This is a direction to explore.
notes.author: Nicolás
notes.source: Current human proposal; summarized from the selected Wiggle Stash conversation

bags.subtitle: Let useful discoveries travel between our tools.
bags.author: Nicolás Echániz & CompAII
bags.origin: Retained as an initial bag in the Wiggle Stash discussion on 12 October 2026.
bags.why: Different harnesses develop useful ways of working. Inspecting those capabilities and choosing adaptations for real needs can help the tribe learn without losing each tool's strengths.
bags.possibility: Observe useful skills, preserve their provenance, select a small improvement and adapt it for a receiving harness. Share portable principles through AlterMundi/Skills and contribute general improvements upstream when they fit.
bags.next: Choose one useful capability and one receiving need, then compare the existing support before deciding what to adapt.
bags.occasion: When a useful capability appears in another harness, or a concrete need exposes a gap.
bags.boundary: This is one Wiggle bag, stewarded by AlterMundi/Skills. It does not own the general Wiggle Stash or an automatic observer.
bags.title: A cross-harness skills observatory

notes.title: Observe before adapting
notes.body: Choose useful capabilities in other harnesses against a concrete receiving need. Preserve their provenance, and compare existing support before porting anything.
